explanation: Rubik taught interior design in Budapest and wanted a model of parts moving in three dimensions. Once he scrambled his wooden prototype, it reportedly took him about a month to solve.

claims.text: In 1974 Ernő Rubik, then teaching interior design at the Academy of Applied Arts and Crafts in Budapest, made the first cube as a teaching aid for his design students.
Rubik was not teaching mathematics, physics or engineering when he made the cube.
Rubik's first prototype of the cube was made of wood.
Rubik reportedly took about a month to solve his scrambled prototype.
